persona.title: Two women died in the same month and the discourse is about whether you are allowed to be sad
persona.why: Two deaths in a month and a discourse about whether you are allowed to be sad. Grief treated them identically and accused of not knowing the difference - the archive register doing its usual work on two idols.

character.title: Entitled to the adulation of all lesser mortals
character.why: Filed character/fictional-protagonist - "somebody described in a book and therefore available to an unlimited number of people at once" - which is where nancy-drew also sits, and the pairing is deliberate: one written character reached by letter for fifty-four years, one reached by club membership.

companion.title: I hope the feeling is mutual
companion.why: Filed companion/social-agent because the shelf it belongs on was opened by the-imaginary-friend, and this is that entry's oldest named instance rather than a variant of it. other: imagined is the clean case on that axis rather than a debatable one: Anne invented Kitty, and knew she had.

divine.title: A cohort nobody in it has met
divine.why: The object is an absence met by negation - a cohort held by what its members are not - rather than a figure who can be petitioned, which separates it cleanly from myth-deity.

institution.title: Thousands of letters, and a handful printed
institution.why: Filed institution/platform - "the intermediary that is also the relationship" - on the test the shelf states: "Is somebody other than you and the performer in a position to change what happens between you?" The magazine held the address, the rationing and the printing.

cosmology.title: The cliffhanger
cosmology.why: End before the answer, fix the slot, leave the question open. The mechanism is the schedule, and the schedule is the thing the bond is actually made of - which is the claim continuity below then dismantles.

officer.title: Shag-eared and deaf
officer.why: The shelf this entry opened. The erastes holds no office and runs no institution: his authority is personal, age-based and wholly unaccountable, which is why the tie is unprotected. Filed under officer/teacher it would have looked tidier and been false, because a teacher has duties and he has none.

predator.title: The crowd injury
predator.why: Fans injured or killed attempting to get closer to a performer, in volume, repeatedly, for years. Not one person harming one other: a crowd, and the attachment as the mechanism.
